newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sembawang gets waiver for offer.
newsitem.headline: Sembawang gets waiver for offer.

text.p: Sembawang Corp Ltd has received a waiver of the requirement to obtain prior shareholder approval for a voluntary takeover offer for all Sembawang Maritime Ltd (SML) shares, Standard Chartered Merchant Bank said.

In a statement issued late on Thursday on Sembawang's behalf, the merchant bankers said the waiver from the Stock Exchange of Singapore clears the way for Sembawang to serve a notice of takeover and despatch an offer document.
Ship-repair conglomerate Sembawang has proposed offering Singapore $3.70 each for outstanding shares in logistics and salvage company SML.
Sembawang already held about a third of SML shares when the proposed takeover offer was announced in August. Analysts view SML as a potentially high growth company.
